\documentclass[
  12pt,
  oneside,
  a4paper,
  chapter=TITLE,
  english,
  portuguese
]{abntex2}

% --- ENCODING ---
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}

% -------------------------------------------------------------------
% FONT  —  controlled by boolean flags generated by build.sh
%
%   font-arial     → Liberation Sans     (identical metrics to Arial)
%   font-helvetica → Nimbus Sans         (free Helvetica, URW)
%   font-ubuntu    → Ubuntu              (classic family)
%   font-times     → TeX Gyre Termes     (free Times New Roman clone)
%
% Default (no flag): TeX Gyre Termes — recommended by ABNT NBR 14724
% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\usepackage{fontspec}
$if(font-arial)$
  \setmainfont{Liberation Sans}
$else$$if(font-helvetica)$
  \setmainfont{Nimbus Sans}
$else$$if(font-ubuntu)$
  \setmainfont{Ubuntu}
$else$
  \setmainfont{TeX Gyre Termes}
$endif$$endif$$endif$

% --- LANGUAGE (XeLaTeX-native, integrates with fontspec) ---
\usepackage{polyglossia}
\setdefaultlanguage[variant=brazilian]{portuguese}

% --- MARGINS (ABNT NBR 14724) ---
\usepackage[a4paper,top=3cm,left=3cm,right=2cm,bottom=2cm]{geometry}

% --- LINE SPACING (ABNT NBR 14724 — 1.5 lines) ---
\usepackage{setspace}
\OnehalfSpacing

% --- ESSENTIAL PACKAGES ---
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{indentfirst}
\usepackage{longtable}
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{array}
\usepackage{calc}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb,amsfonts}
\usepackage{textcomp}
\usepackage{color,xcolor}
\usepackage{listings}
\usepackage{fancyvrb}
\usepackage{upquote}
\usepackage{csquotes}
\usepackage{microtype}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\hypersetup{
  colorlinks=true,
  linkcolor=black,
  filecolor=black,
  urlcolor=black,
  citecolor=black,
}
% --- FIGURE PLACEMENT ---
% LaTeX's default float algorithm ([htbp]) repositions figures freely,
% causing images to appear far from their insertion point and overlap
% paragraphs. [H] forces each figure to appear exactly where declared.
\usepackage{float}
\usepackage{caption}
\floatplacement{figure}{H}

% -------------------------------------------------------------------
% FIRST-PARAGRAPH INDENT AFTER CHAPTER HEADING
%
% abntex2's \chapter calls \@afterindentfalse internally, which
% instructs LaTeX to suppress indentation on the first paragraph after
% every heading — regardless of \parindent value and even with the
% indentfirst package loaded, because abntex2 redefines \chapter in a
% way that bypasses the indentfirst hook.
%
% Fix: redefine \@afterindentfalse as an alias for \@afterindenttrue
% in the preamble, making it a permanent no-op. No heading can
% suppress the indent — the 1.3 cm \parindent is always applied.
% -------------------------------------------------------------------

% --- PANDOC CODE HIGHLIGHTING ---
\DefineVerbatimEnvironment{Highlighting}{Verbatim}{commandchars=\\\{\}}
\newenvironment{Shaded}{}{}
\newcommand{\passthrough}[1]{#1}
\providecommand{\tightlist}{%
  \setlength{\itemsep}{0pt}\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}}
\newcommand{\KeywordTok}[1]{\textcolor{blue}{\textbf{#1}}}
\newcommand{\ControlFlowTok}[1]{\textcolor{blue}{\textbf{#1}}}
\newcommand{\StringTok}[1]{\textcolor{blue}{#1}}
\newcommand{\CommentTok}[1]{\textcolor{gray}{\textit{#1}}}
\newcommand{\FunctionTok}[1]{\textcolor{cyan}{#1}}
\newcommand{\NormalTok}[1]{#1}
\newcommand{\OtherTok}[1]{#1}
\newcommand{\ErrorTok}[1]{\textcolor{red}{#1}}
\newcommand{\DataTypeTok}[1]{\textcolor{purple}{#1}}
\newcommand{\DecValTok}[1]{\textcolor{orange}{#1}}
\newcommand{\AttributeTok}[1]{\textcolor{orange}{#1}}
\newcommand{\BuiltInTok}[1]{\textcolor{purple}{#1}}
\newcommand{\ImportTok}[1]{\textcolor{teal}{#1}}
\newcommand{\VariableTok}[1]{\textcolor{black}{#1}}
\newcommand{\OperatorTok}[1]{#1}
\newcommand{\ExtensionTok}[1]{#1}
\newcommand{\SpecialCharTok}[1]{\textcolor{violet}{#1}}
\newcommand{\DocumentationTok}[1]{\textcolor{gray}{\itshape #1}}
\newcommand{\AnnotationTok}[1]{\textcolor{red}{\textbf{#1}}}
\newcommand{\CommentVarTok}[1]{\textcolor{gray}{\itshape #1}}
\newcommand{\ConstantTok}[1]{\textcolor{red}{#1}}
\newcommand{\SpecialStringTok}[1]{\textcolor{violet}{#1}}
\newcommand{\VerbatimStringTok}[1]{\textcolor{green}{#1}}
\newcommand{\CharTok}[1]{\textcolor{green}{#1}}
\newcommand{\BaseNTok}[1]{\textcolor{orange}{#1}}
\newcommand{\FloatTok}[1]{\textcolor{orange}{#1}}
\newcommand{\PreprocessorTok}[1]{\textcolor{purple}{\textbf{#1}}}
\newcommand{\RegionMarkerTok}[1]{#1}
\newcommand{\InformationTok}[1]{\textcolor{gray}{\itshape #1}}
\newcommand{\WarningTok}[1]{\textcolor{red}{\textbf{#1}}}
\newcommand{\AlertTok}[1]{\textcolor{red}{\textbf{#1}}}

% -------------------------------------------------------------------
% METADATA
% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\titulo{$title$}
\autor{$for(author)$$if(author.name)$$author.name$$else$$author$$endif$$sep$\\$endfor$}
\instituicao{$if(institution)$$institution$$else$Instituição de Ensino$endif$}
\local{$if(city)$$city$$else$Cidade$endif$}
\data{$if(year)$$year$$else$\the\year$endif$}

% -------------------------------------------------------------------
% HEADING STYLE NORMALISATION
% ABNT NBR 14724 specifies 12 pt for all section headings.
% abntex2 defaults to sizes larger than \normalsize for \section and
% below; override all levels to match the chapter heading size.
% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\renewcommand{\ABNTEXchapterfont}{\bfseries}
\renewcommand{\ABNTEXchapterfontsize}{\normalsize}
\renewcommand{\ABNTEXsectionfontsize}{\normalsize}
\renewcommand{\ABNTEXsubsectionfontsize}{\normalsize}
\renewcommand{\ABNTEXsubsubsectionfontsize}{\normalsize}
\renewcommand{\ABNTEXsubsubsubsectionfontsize}{\normalsize}

% -------------------------------------------------------------------
\begin{document}
\frenchspacing

% =====================================================================
% COVER PAGE  (ABNT NBR 14724)
% =====================================================================
\begin{capa}
  \center

  $if(logo)$
  \includegraphics[width=$if(logo-width)$$logo-width$$else$0.12$endif$\textwidth]{$logo$}\\[0.3cm]
  $endif$

  {\ABNTEXchapterfont\bfseries\large
    \MakeUppercase{$if(institution)$$institution$$else$INSTITUIÇÃO DE ENSINO$endif$}\\
    $if(campus)$\MakeUppercase{$campus$}\\$endif$
    $if(department)$\MakeUppercase{$department$}\\$endif$
    $if(program)$\MakeUppercase{$program$}$endif$
  }\\[2.5cm]

  {\ABNTEXchapterfont\bfseries\large
    $for(author)$$if(author.name)$\MakeUppercase{$author.name$}$else$\MakeUppercase{$author$}$endif$$sep$\\$endfor$
  }\\[4cm]

  {\ABNTEXchapterfont\bfseries\large
    \MakeUppercase{$title$}$if(subtitle)$: $subtitle$$endif$
  }\\[\fill]

  {\ABNTEXchapterfont\large
    \MakeUppercase{$if(city)$$city$$else$CIDADE$endif$}$if(state)$ -- $state$$endif$\\
    $if(year)$$year$$else$\the\year$endif$
  }
\end{capa}

% =====================================================================
% TITLE PAGE  (ABNT NBR 14724)
% =====================================================================
\begin{folhaderosto}
  \center

  {\ABNTEXchapterfont\bfseries\large
    $for(author)$$if(author.name)$\MakeUppercase{$author.name$}$else$\MakeUppercase{$author$}$endif$$sep$\\$endfor$
  }\\[15\baselineskip]

  {\ABNTEXchapterfont\bfseries\large
    \MakeUppercase{$title$}$if(subtitle)$: $subtitle$$endif$
  }\\[2cm]

  \hspace*{8cm}
  \parbox{8cm}{\normalsize\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}\normalfont
    $if(nature)$$nature$$else$%
      Tese apresentada como requisito parcial à obtenção
      do título de $if(degree)$$degree$$else$Doutor(a)$endif$,
      $if(program)$do $program$,$endif$
      $if(institution)$da $institution$$if(campus)$, $campus$$endif$$endif$.
    $endif$
  }\\[0.8cm]

  $if(area)$
  \hspace*{8cm}
  \parbox{8cm}{\normalsize\normalfontÁrea de Concentração: $area$}\\[0.5cm]
  $endif$

  $if(advisor)$
  \hspace*{8cm}
  \parbox{8cm}{\normalsize\normalfont
    $if(advisor-label)$$advisor-label$$else$Orientador(a)$endif$: $advisor$
  }\\[0.5cm]
  $endif$

  $if(coadvisor)$
  \hspace*{8cm}
  \parbox{8cm}{\normalsize\normalfont
    $if(coadvisor-label)$$coadvisor-label$$else$Coorientador(a)$endif$: $coadvisor$
  }\\[0.5cm]
  $endif$

  \vfill

  {\ABNTEXchapterfont\large
    \MakeUppercase{$if(city)$$city$$else$CIDADE$endif$}$if(state)$ -- $state$$endif$\\
    $if(year)$$year$$else$\the\year$endif$
  }
\end{folhaderosto}

% =====================================================================
% CATALOGUING SHEET — ficha catalográfica (mandatory for PhD theses)
% =====================================================================
$if(catalog-image)$
\newpage
\thispagestyle{empty}
\vspace*{\fill}
\begin{center}
  \includegraphics[width=12.5cm,height=7.5cm,keepaspectratio]{$catalog-image$}
\end{center}
$endif$

% =====================================================================
% APPROVAL SHEET  (ABNT NBR 14724)
% =====================================================================
$if(approval-date)$
\newpage
\thispagestyle{empty}
\begin{center}
  {\ABNTEXchapterfont\bfseries\large
    $for(author)$$if(author.name)$\MakeUppercase{$author.name$}$else$\MakeUppercase{$author$}$endif$$sep$\\$endfor$
  }\\[1cm]
  {\ABNTEXchapterfont\bfseries\large \MakeUppercase{$title$}}\\[1cm]
  \hspace*{8cm}\parbox{8cm}{\normalsize\normalfont
    $if(nature)$$nature$$else$Tese de Doutorado$endif$
  }\\[1cm]
  Aprovado em: $approval-date$\\[2cm]
  {\bfseries BANCA EXAMINADORA}\\[1.5cm]
  $for(committee)$
  \rule{8cm}{0.4pt}\\
  $if(committee.title)$$committee.title$ $endif$$committee.name$\\
  $if(committee.institution)$$committee.institution$$endif$\\[1.5cm]
  $endfor$
\end{center}
$endif$

% =====================================================================
% DEDICATION
% =====================================================================
$if(dedication)$
\newpage
\thispagestyle{empty}
\vspace*{\fill}
\hspace*{8cm}\parbox{8cm}{\normalfont\itshape $dedication$}
$endif$

% =====================================================================
% ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS
% =====================================================================
$if(acknowledgements)$
\newpage
\thispagestyle{empty}
\begin{center}{\ABNTEXchapterfont\bfseries\normalsize AGRADECIMENTOS}\end{center}
\vspace{\onelineskip}
$acknowledgements$
\clearpage
$endif$

% =====================================================================
% EPIGRAPH
% =====================================================================
$if(epigraph)$
\newpage
\thispagestyle{empty}
\vspace*{\fill}
\hspace*{8cm}\parbox{8cm}{\normalfont\itshape
  ``$epigraph$''\\
  $if(epigraph-author)$\hfill --- $epigraph-author$$endif$
}
$endif$

% =====================================================================
% RESUMO (PT)
% =====================================================================
$if(abstract-pt)$
\newpage
\thispagestyle{empty}
\begin{resumoumacoluna}
\noindent\textbf{RESUMO:}\vspace{\onelineskip}

$abstract-pt$

\vspace{\onelineskip}
\noindent\textbf{Palavras-chave}: $if(keywords-pt)$$keywords-pt$$endif$.
\end{resumoumacoluna}
\clearpage
$endif$

% =====================================================================
% ABSTRACT (EN)
% =====================================================================
$if(abstract-en)$
\newpage
\thispagestyle{empty}
\renewcommand{\resumoname}{Abstract}
\begin{resumoumacoluna}
\noindent\textbf{ABSTRACT:}\vspace{\onelineskip}

$abstract-en$

\vspace{\onelineskip}
\noindent\textbf{Keywords}: $if(keywords-en)$$keywords-en$$endif$.
\end{resumoumacoluna}
\clearpage
$endif$

% =====================================================================
% LIST OF FIGURES
% =====================================================================
$if(list-of-figures)$
\pdfbookmark[0]{\listfigurename}{lof}
\listoffigures*
\cleardoublepage
$endif$

% =====================================================================
% LIST OF TABLES
% =====================================================================
$if(list-of-tables)$
\pdfbookmark[0]{\listtablename}{lot}
\listoftables*
\cleardoublepage
$endif$

% =====================================================================
% LIST OF ABBREVIATIONS
% =====================================================================
$if(abbreviations)$
\begin{siglas}
$for(abbreviations)$
  \item[$abbreviations.key$] $abbreviations.value$
$endfor$
\end{siglas}
$endif$

% =====================================================================
% LIST OF SYMBOLS
% =====================================================================
$if(symbols)$
\begin{simbolos}
$for(symbols)$
  \item[$symbols.key$] $symbols.value$
$endfor$
\end{simbolos}
$endif$

% =====================================================================
% TABLE OF CONTENTS
% =====================================================================
\pdfbookmark[0]{\contentsname}{toc}
\tableofcontents*
\cleardoublepage

% =====================================================================
% TEXTUAL BODY
% =====================================================================
\textual
\makeatletter
\let\@afterindentfalse\@afterindenttrue
\makeatother
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{3}
% Fix: \textual resets internal spacing state in abntex2, causing the first
% paragraph of the body to lose its indentation. Restoring \parindent and
% forcing indentation for the first paragraph.
\setlength{\parindent}{1.3cm}

$body$

% =====================================================================
% POST-TEXTUAL ELEMENTS
% =====================================================================
\postextual

$if(bibliography)$
\bibliographystyle{abntex2-alf}
\bibliography{$bibliography$}
$endif$

$if(glossary)$
\begin{glossario}
$glossary$
\end{glossario}
$endif$

$if(appendix)$
\begin{apendicesenv}
$appendix$
\end{apendicesenv}
$endif$

$if(annex)$
\begin{anexosenv}
$annex$
\end{anexosenv}
$endif$

\end{document}
